description: Defines the RuleNodeDebugEvent class, a data model for debug events related to rule nodes in the Thingsboard platform, including serialization and conversion to event info.

classes.name: RuleNodeDebugEvent
classes.description: A class representing a debug event for a rule node, including event details, serialization, and conversion to EventInfo.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the event type, specifically EventType.DEBUG_RULE_NODE.

methods.name: toInfo
methods.description: Converts the event to an EventInfo object, including serializing event details into JSON.
